title: 第19章 帮你筹集军备第20章 将军活的鸡
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 叶苜苜联系商家客服，询问铠甲报价和性能。
大部分商家制作古代铠甲，是给coS玩家提供的，也有提供影视剧拍摄道具，真实效果如何，他们自己也不清楚。
她咨询十多个商家，有一家专门做仿古兵器的，有自家生产工厂。
她所需要数量庞大，老板亲自和她视频连线。
并且给她试了，用长剑砍盔甲。
呯~
一串火花，剑上有缺口，盔甲依旧完好无损。
老板镜头靠近盔甲，让叶苜苜看得更清楚，盔甲上有划痕，没有断掉。
叶苜苜说：“我看店铺还有开过刃地刀剑，你用自家的刀，砍自家的盔甲试试。”
这么玩，老板都有些为难。
她又说：“我订购数量上万起步，老板，你得让我知道盔甲的坚硬程度。”
听见上万起步，是前所未有的大单。
老板高举手机，视频进入兵器展览厅。
这家工厂不止是生产盔甲，也生产仿古兵器。
汉朝的赤霄剑，秀霸剑，环手刀。
唐朝的陌刀，唐横刀。
明朝的雁翎腰刀，狼牙棒……应有尽有！
叶苜苜看上了唐朝陌刀，历史上，唐朝用陌刀追着北方游牧民族砍。
陌刀长约一米六，横向能砍断马腿，很适合战家军抵御蛮族。
见叶苜苜点名试唐陌刀，老板冷汗涔涔。
他也没试过，为了这一万订单，他取下刀，拔刀出鞘。
刀身很长，寒光凛凛，银白刀身能映照出人影。
老板在叶苜苜要求下，用最大力气砍盔甲。
砰~
一串迸发的火花后，刀身完好无损，有一个小小豁口。
盔甲断掉两片，穿盔甲的模型一道细微浅浅伤痕。
老板见状，心想这一单黄了。
叶苜苜却问：“老板库房里有多少盔甲？”
“一千副。”
盔甲造价太高，他生产出一千多幅，卖了五年，现在还有一千副。
叶苜苜说：“我全要了！”
老板不敢相信。
这盔甲放在仓库吃灰了五年，投了大批资金进去，家里都快把他骂自闭了。
content_en:
Ye Clover contacted the merchant's customer service and inquired about the quotation and performance of the armor.
Most merchants make ancient armors to provide COS players, and also provide props for film and television drama shooting. They themselves don't know the actual effect.
She consulted more than a dozen merchants, one of which specialized in antique weapons and had its own production factory.
The quantity she needed was huge, and the boss had a video chat with her in person.
And he tried it on her, cutting the armor with his long sword.
Bah~
A trail of sparks, a chip on the sword, the armor still intact.
The boss' camera was close to the armor, allowing Ye Clover to see more clearly. There were scratches on the armor, but it was not broken.
Ye Clover said: "I see that the store also has open-edged swords. You can try cutting your own armor with your own sword."
Playing like this makes the boss a little embarrassed.
She added: "My order quantity will start at tens of thousands. Boss, you have to let me know how hard the armor is."
I heard that the starting price is tens of thousands, which is an unprecedented large order.
The boss held up his mobile phone and video entered the weapons exhibition hall.
This factory not only produces armor, but also produces antique weapons.
The Chixiao Sword, Xiuba Sword, and Huanshou Sword of the Han Dynasty.
The Mo Dao and Tang Heng Dao of the Tang Dynasty.
Yanling waist knives, maces from the Ming Dynasty... everything is available!
Alfalfa fell in love with the Tang Dynasty Modao. Historically, the Tang Dynasty used the Modao to chase the nomadic people in the north.
The Mo Dao is about 1.6 meters long and can cut off a horse's legs horizontally. It is very suitable for the Zhan family's army to resist the barbarians.
The boss was sweating coldly when he saw Ye Clover calling his name to try on Tang Mo Dao.
He didn't try it either. For the order of 10,000, he took off the knife and drew it out of its sheath.
The blade is very long, the cold light shines brightly, and the silver-white blade can reflect the figures of people.
The boss, at Ye Clover's request, used all his strength to chop the armor.
Bang~
After a burst of sparks, the blade was intact, with a small gap.
The armor was broken into two pieces, and the model wearing the armor had a slight scratch.
When the boss saw this, he thought the order was gone.
Ye Clover asked: "How many armors are there in the boss's warehouse?"
"A thousand pairs."
The armor was too expensive to make, so he produced more than a thousand pieces and sold them for five years, and now still has a thousand pairs.
Leaf Clover said: "I want them all!"
The boss couldn't believe it.
This armor has been sitting in a warehouse gathering dust for five years. After a large amount of money was invested in it, his family almost scolded him for being autistic.
